feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 October 2026 12:19pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 19 October 2026 at 12:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Scandinavia extending a ridge across the area, a shallow low over France bringing a weak front at first.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5, little change.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, some patchy light rain or drizzle in the southeast at first, then outbreaks of rain arriving from the east tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5, veering south or southwest Tuesday afternoon, then veering west 4 to 6 overnight into Wednesday. Increasing 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate overnight into Wednesday, then mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain mainly in the east at first, then further rain from the west overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
